```{r}
neg.log.likelihood.fatigue.unified <- function(par, copper_data, 
                                               dist_type = "lognormal", 
                                               prior_type = "gamma") {
  # 1. 參數解析 (直接讀取，不使用 exp)
  beta0 <- par[1]
  beta1 <- par[2]
  kappa <- par[3] # 直接是原始 kappa
  
  if (prior_type == "exponential") {
    delta <- 1
    gamma_limit <- par[4]
  } else {
    delta <- par[4] # 直接是原始 delta
    gamma_limit <- par[5]
  }

  # 2. 基本物理與邊界檢查
  # 加入 kappa 與 delta 必須 > 0 的檢查
  if (kappa <= 0 || delta <= 0) return(1e12)
  
  min_stress_fail <- min(copper_data$stress[copper_data$censoring == 1])
  if (gamma_limit >= min_stress_fail || gamma_limit <= 0) return(1e12)
  
  fail_idx <- copper_data$censoring == 1
  log_jacobian_total <- -sum(log(copper_data$cycles[fail_idx]))
  
  total_log_likelihood <- 0
  stress_levels <- unique(copper_data$stress)
  
  for (stress in stress_levels) {
    curr <- copper_data[copper_data$stress == stress, ]
    mu_j <- beta0 + beta1 * log(stress - gamma_limit) 
    
    log_y <- log(curr$cycles)
    cens <- curr$censoring
    
    # 3. 定義被積函數
    integrand_log <- function(s2) {
      s <- sqrt(s2)
      z <- (log_y - mu_j) / s
      
      if (dist_type == "lognormal") {
        term_obs <- ifelse(cens == 1, 
                           dnorm(z, log = TRUE) - log(s), 
                           pnorm(z, lower.tail = FALSE, log.p = TRUE))
      } else if (dist_type == "weibull") {
        term_obs <- ifelse(cens == 1, 
                           z - exp(z) - log(s), 
                           -exp(z))
      }
      
      term_prior <- switch(prior_type,
        "gamma"       = (delta - 1) * log(s2) - (kappa * s2),
        "exponential" = - (kappa * s2),
        "inv_gamma"   = -(delta + 1) * log(s2) - (kappa / s2)
      )
      
      return(sum(term_obs) + term_prior)
    }

    test_s2 <- c(0.0001, 0.01, 1, 10)
    sample_v <- sapply(test_s2, integrand_log)
    C <- max(sample_v[is.finite(sample_v)], -700)

    integrand_stable <- function(s2) {
      vapply(s2, function(x) {
        val <- exp(integrand_log(x) - C)
        return(if (is.finite(val)) val else 0)
      }, numeric(1))
    }

    itg <- try(integrate(integrand_stable, lower = 1e-10, upper = Inf, rel.tol = 1e-7), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(itg, "try-error") || itg$value <= 0) return(1e12)
    
    # 5. 標準化常數 (使用原始參數)
    norm_const <- switch(prior_type,
      "gamma"       = delta * log(kappa) - lgamma(delta),
      "exponential" = log(kappa),
      "inv_gamma"   = delta * log(kappa) - lgamma(delta)
    )
    
    total_log_likelihood <- total_log_likelihood + norm_const + C + log(itg$value)
  }
  
  final_nll <- -(total_log_likelihood + log_jacobian_total)
  return(if (is.finite(final_nll)) final_nll else 1e12)
}
```

```{r}
fit.fatigue.model <- function(copper_data, 
                              dist_type = "lognormal", 
                              prior_type = "gamma",
                              init_values = NULL) {
  
  x_minf <- min(copper_data$stress[copper_data$censoring == 1])
  
  # 初始值與邊界設定 (去除 log 轉換)
  if (prior_type == "exponential") {
    # 參數: beta0, beta1, kappa, gamma
    if (is.null(init_values)) init_values <- c(20, -2, 1, x_minf * 0.9)
    lower_b <- c(0, -Inf, 1e-6, 0.001) # kappa 下限設為 1e-6
    upper_b <- c(Inf, 0, Inf, x_minf - 0.001)
    par_names <- c("beta0", "beta1", "kappa", "gamma")
  } else {
    # 參數: beta0, beta1, kappa, delta, gamma
    if (is.null(init_values)) init_values <- c(20, -2, 1, 2, x_minf * 0.9)
    lower_b <- c(0, -Inf, 1e-6, 1e-6, 0.001) # kappa, delta 下限設為 1e-6
    upper_b <- c(Inf, 0, Inf, Inf, x_minf - 0.001)
    par_names <- c("beta0", "beta1", "kappa", "delta", "gamma")
  }
  
  fit_res <- optim(
    par = init_values,
    fn = neg.log.likelihood.fatigue.unified, 
    copper_data = copper_data,
    dist_type = dist_type,
    prior_type = prior_type,
    method = "L-BFGS-B",
    lower = lower_b,
    upper = upper_b,
    hessian = TRUE,
    control = list(trace = 1, maxit = 1000, factr = 1e7)
  )
  
  if (fit_res$convergence == 0) {
    names(fit_res$par) <- par_names
    cat("\n=== 最佳估計結果 (原始尺度) ===\n")
    print(round(fit_res$par, 4))
    
    k <- length(fit_res$par)
    fit_res$aic <- 2 * fit_res$value + 2 * k
    cat("\nAIC 值:", fit_res$aic, "\n")
  }
  
  return(fit_res)
}
```

```{r}
library(stats)

calculate_sigma_posterior_v4 <- function(opt_obj, data,
                                         distribution = c("lognormal", "weibull"),
                                         prior_type = c("inv_gamma", "gamma", "exp"),
                                         use_prior_mean = FALSE) {
  
  distribution <- match.arg(distribution)
  prior_type <- match.arg(prior_type)
  par <- opt_obj$par
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. 參數提取 (配合原始尺度優化，不使用 exp())
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  beta0 <- par[1]
  beta1 <- par[2]
  
  if (prior_type == "exp") {
    kappa <- par[3]
    delta <- 1
    gamma_fatigue <- par[4]
  } else {
    # 這裡直接取原始值，不再取 exp()，與你最新的 neg.log.likelihood 一致
    kappa <- par[3]
    delta <- par[4]
    gamma_fatigue <- par[5]
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. 計算先驗的理論期望值 (Theory Prior Mean of Sigma^2)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  theoretical_sigma_sq <- NA
  if (use_prior_mean) {
    if (prior_type == "inv_gamma") {
      theoretical_sigma_sq <- if (delta > 1) kappa / (delta - 1) else Inf
    } else if (prior_type == "gamma") {
      theoretical_sigma_sq <- delta / kappa
    } else if (prior_type == "exp") {
      theoretical_sigma_sq <- 1 / kappa
    }
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. 數據準備
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  if ("sigma" %in% names(data) && !"stress" %in% names(data)) {
    data$stress <- data$sigma
  }
  stress_levels <- sort(unique(data$stress))
  results <- data.frame()
  
  for (stress in stress_levels) {
    current_data <- data[data$stress == stress, ]
    log_times <- log(current_data$cycles)
    cens <- current_data$censoring
    n_f <- sum(cens == 1)
    
    # 計算 mu_j
    stress_adj <- stress - gamma_fatigue
    mu_j <- if (stress_adj > 0) beta0 + beta1 * log(stress_adj) else NA
    
    sigma_j_squared <- NA
    
    if (use_prior_mean) {
      sigma_j_squared <- theoretical_sigma_sq
    } else if (!is.na(mu_j)) {
      
      # 內部積分函數：計算後驗期望值 E[sigma^2 | Data]
      # 為了穩定，先找 max_log_target
      calc_log_target <- function(s2, calc_num = FALSE) {
        if (s2 <= 0) return(-Inf)
        sigma_j <- sqrt(s2)
        z <- (log_times - mu_j) / sigma_j
        
        # Likelihood 項 (注意：Weibull 是 SEV 分佈)
        if (distribution == "lognormal") {
          # 失效用 phi(z)/s, 截尾用 1-Phi(z)
          term_obs <- sum(ifelse(cens == 1, 
                                 dnorm(z, log = TRUE) - log(sigma_j), 
                                 pnorm(z, lower.tail = FALSE, log.p = TRUE)))
        } else {
          # Weibull (SEV): 失效用 z-exp(z)-log(s), 截尾用 -exp(z)
          term_obs <- sum(ifelse(cens == 1, 
                                 z - exp(z) - log(sigma_j), 
                                 -exp(z)))
        }
        
        # Prior 項 (與優化時的公式一致)
        log_prior <- switch(prior_type,
          "gamma"       = (delta - 1) * log(s2) - (kappa * s2),
          "exp"         = - (kappa * s2),
          "inv_gamma"   = -(delta + 1) * log(s2) - (kappa / s2)
        )
        
        res <- term_obs + log_prior
        if (calc_num) res <- res + log(s2)
        return(res)
      }

      # 數值穩定化處理 (Offset C)
      test_s2 <- c(0.001, 0.1, 1, 10)
      vals <- sapply(test_s2, calc_log_target, calc_num = FALSE)
      C <- max(vals[is.finite(vals)], -700)
      
      integrand_stable <- function(s2, calc_num) {
        vapply(s2, function(x) {
          log_val <- calc_log_target(x, calc_num)
          res <- exp(log_val - C)
          return(if (is.finite(res)) res else 0)
        }, numeric(1))
      }

      denom <- try(integrate(integrand_stable, 0, Inf, calc_num = FALSE, rel.tol = 1e-8)$value, silent = TRUE)
      numer <- try(integrate(integrand_stable, 0, Inf, calc_num = TRUE, rel.tol = 1e-8)$value, silent = TRUE)
      
      if (!inherits(denom, "try-error") && !inherits(numer, "try-error") && denom > 0) {
        sigma_j_squared <- numer / denom
      }
    }
    
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      stress_level = stress,
      sigma_j_squared = sigma_j_squared,
      sigma_j = sqrt(sigma_j_squared),
      mu = mu_j,
      n_fail = n_f,
      n_runout = sum(cens == 0),
      type = ifelse(use_prior_mean, "Prior Mean", "Posterior Mean")
    ))
  }
  
  return(results)
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

plot_fatigue_curves <- function(sigma_table, raw_data, 
                                distribution = c("lognormal", "weibull"), 
                                probs = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9),
                                title_text = NULL) {
  
  dist_type <- match.arg(distribution)
  
  # 1. 準備繪圖用的分位數數據 (Line Data)
  # 直接使用 sigma_table 中的 mu 和 sigma_j，不需重新計算 beta
  line_data <- data.frame()
  
  for (p in probs) {
    temp_df <- sigma_table %>%
      mutate(p = p,
             p_label = scales::percent(p)) # 轉成 "10%", "50%" 格式
    
    # 計算分位數 (Quantile Calculation)
    if (dist_type == "lognormal") {
      # Lognormal: exp(mu + sigma * z_p)
      #
      temp_df$cycle <- exp(temp_df$mu + temp_df$sigma_j * qnorm(p))
      
    } else if (dist_type == "weibull") {
      # Weibull: exp(mu + sigma * log(-log(1-p)))
      #
      temp_df$cycle <- exp(temp_df$mu + temp_df$sigma_j * log(-log(1 - p)))
    }
    
    line_data <- rbind(line_data, temp_df)
  }
  
  # 確保 p_label 的順序 (讓圖例照大小排)
  line_data$p_label <- factor(line_data$p_label, 
                              levels = scales::percent(sort(probs)))
  
  # 2. 處理原始數據 (Raw Data)
  # 確保欄位名稱統一
  if ("sigma" %in% names(raw_data) && !"stress" %in% names(raw_data)) {
    raw_data$stress <- raw_data$sigma
  }
  
  # 3. 設定標題
  if (is.null(title_text)) {
    title_text <- paste("S-N Diagram (", tools::toTitleCase(dist_type), ")", sep="")
  }
  
  # 4. 繪圖 (ggplot2)
  p_plot <- ggplot() +
    # A. 原始數據散佈圖
    geom_point(data = raw_data, aes(x = cycles, y = stress, shape = factor(censoring)), 
               color = "blue", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    
    # B. 分位數曲線 (連接各應力點)
    geom_path(data = line_data, 
              aes(x = cycle, y = stress_level, color = p_label, group = p_label), 
              linewidth = 1) +
    
    # C. 形狀與顏色設定
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("0" = 2, "1" = 16), # 0=三角形(Runout), 1=圓點(Failure)
      labels = c("0" = "Runout", "1" = "Failure"),
      name = "Status"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      # 根據你的喜好設定顏色
      values = c("10%" = "green", "50%" = "red", "90%" = "purple", 
                 "1%" = "gray", "5%" = "orange", "95%" = "darkblue"),
      name = "Quantile"
    ) +
    
    # D. 座標軸設定 (Log-Log Scale)
    scale_x_continuous(
      trans = "log", 
      breaks = scales::trans_breaks("log10", function(x) 10^x),
      labels = scales::trans_format(function(x) log10(x), scales::math_format(10^.x))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      trans = "log",
      labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)
    ) +
    
    # E. 標籤與主題
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "thousands of cycles",
      y = "stress"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  return(p_plot)
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

plot_comparison_curves <- function(model_results_list, raw_data, 
                                   probs = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9),
                                   title_text = "Comparison: Lognormal vs Weibull") {
  
  # 1. 合併所有模型的結果
  # 假設 model_results_list 是一個 list，裡面包含由 calculate_sigma_posterior_v3 輸出的 data frame
  combined_sigma_table <- do.call(rbind, model_results_list)
  
  # 2. 準備繪圖用的分位數數據 (Line Data)
  line_data <- data.frame()
  
  for (p in probs) {
    # 複製一份數據並標記當前的機率 p
    temp_df <- combined_sigma_table %>%
      mutate(p = p,
             p_label = scales::percent(p))
    
    # 3. 根據模型類型計算對應的分位數 (Vectorized calculation)
    # Lognormal 公式: exp(mu + sigma * qnorm(p)) [cite: 110]
    # Weibull 公式: exp(mu + sigma * log(-log(1-p))) [cite: 509]
    
    temp_df$cycle <- NA # 初始化
    
    # 計算 Lognormal 部分
    is_ln <- temp_df$model == "lognormal"
    if (any(is_ln)) {
      temp_df$cycle[is_ln] <- exp(temp_df$mu[is_ln] + temp_df$sigma_j[is_ln] * qnorm(p))
    }
    
    # 計算 Weibull 部分
    is_wb <- temp_df$model == "weibull"
    if (any(is_wb)) {
      temp_df$cycle[is_wb] <- exp(temp_df$mu[is_wb] + temp_df$sigma_j[is_wb] * log(-log(1 - p)))
    }
    
    line_data <- rbind(line_data, temp_df)
  }
  
  # 排序 p_label 確保圖例順序
  line_data$p_label <- factor(line_data$p_label, levels = scales::percent(sort(probs)))
  
  # 確保 model 欄位是 factor 以便控制順序 (讓 Lognormal 排前面)
  line_data$model <- factor(line_data$model, levels = c("lognormal", "weibull"))
  
  # 4. 處理原始數據欄位名稱
  if ("sigma" %in% names(raw_data) && !"stress" %in% names(raw_data)) {
    raw_data$stress <- raw_data$sigma
  }
  
  # 5. 繪圖
  p_plot <- ggplot() +
    # A. 原始數據點
    geom_point(data = raw_data, aes(x = cycles, y = stress, shape = factor(censoring)), 
               color = "blue", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
    
    # B. 繪製曲線
    # 關鍵：linetype = model (控制實線/虛線), color = p_label (控制顏色)
    geom_path(data = line_data, 
              aes(x = cycle, y = stress_level, 
                  color = p_label, 
                  linetype = model, 
                  group = interaction(p_label, model)), # 確保線條正確分組
              linewidth = 1) +
    
    # C. 設定線型 (Lognormal=Solid, Weibull=Dashed)
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("lognormal" = "solid", "weibull" = "dashed"), # 這裡設定虛線 
      labels = c("lognormal" = "Lognormal", "weibull" = "Weibull"),
      name = "Distribution"
    ) +
    
    # D. 設定顏色
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("10%" = "green", "50%" = "red", "90%" = "purple", 
                 "5%" = "orange", "95%" = "darkblue", "1%"="gray"),
      name = "Quantile"
    ) +
    
    # E. 設定形狀標籤
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("0" = 2, "1" = 16),
      labels = c("0" = "Runout", "1" = "Failure"),
      name = "Status"
    ) +
    
    # F. 座標軸與標題
    scale_x_continuous(
      trans = "log", 
      breaks = scales::trans_breaks("log10", function(x) 10^x),
      labels = scales::trans_format(function(x) log10(x), scales::math_format(10^.x))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      trans = "log",
      labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "thousands of cycles ",
      y = "stress"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical" # 讓圖例垂直排列比較整齊
    )
  
  return(p_plot)
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

plot_random_effect_dist <- function(
    mode = c("compare", "lognormal", "weibull"), # 繪圖模式
    
    # --- 新增：選擇分佈類型 ---
    ln_prior_type = c("inv_gamma", "gamma", "exp"), # Lognormal 的 Prior 類型
    wb_prior_type = c("inv_gamma", "gamma", "exp"), # Weibull 的 Prior 類型
    
    # --- 參數設定 (kappa, delta) ---
    # Exponential 分佈只會用到 kappa (作為 rate)，忽略 delta
    ln_params = list(kappa = 0.005, delta = 2.5), 
    wb_params = list(kappa = 20, delta = 5),      
    
    x_max = 0.5,  # X 軸最大值
    y_max = 20    # Y 軸最大值
) {
  
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  ln_prior_type <- match.arg(ln_prior_type)
  wb_prior_type <- match.arg(wb_prior_type)
  
  # 1. 建立 X 軸序列
  x_seq <- seq(0.0001, x_max, length.out = 1000)
  df_plot <- data.frame()
  
  # --- 內部函數：定義 PDF ---
  # 用來統一處理三種分佈的計算邏輯
  get_pdf_values <- function(x, type, params) {
    k <- params$kappa
    d <- params$delta
    
    if (type == "inv_gamma") {
      # Inverse Gamma: shape=delta, scale=kappa
      # f(x) = (scale^shape / Gamma(shape)) * x^(-shape - 1) * exp(-scale / x)
      return( (k^d / gamma(d)) * x^(-d - 1) * exp(-k / x) )
      
    } else if (type == "gamma") {
      # Gamma: shape=delta, rate=kappa
      return( dgamma(x, shape = d, rate = k) )
      
    } else if (type == "exp") {
      # Exponential: rate=kappa (delta 被忽略)
      return( dexp(x, rate = k) )
    }
  }
  
  # --- 2. 產生 Lognormal 資料 ---
  if (mode %in% c("compare", "lognormal")) {
    dens_ln <- get_pdf_values(x_seq, ln_prior_type, ln_params)
    
    # 標籤加上分佈類型，讓圖例更清楚 (可選)
    # model_label <- paste0("Lognormal (", ln_prior_type, ")")
    model_label <- "Lognormal"
    
    df_ln <- data.frame(
      sigma_sq = x_seq,
      density = dens_ln,
      Model = model_label
    )
    df_plot <- bind_rows(df_plot, df_ln)
  }
  
  # --- 3. 產生 Weibull 資料 ---
  if (mode %in% c("compare", "weibull")) {
    dens_wb <- get_pdf_values(x_seq, wb_prior_type, wb_params)
    
    # model_label <- paste0("Weibull (", wb_prior_type, ")")
    model_label <- "Weibull"
    
    df_wb <- data.frame(
      sigma_sq = x_seq,
      density = dens_wb,
      Model = model_label
    )
    df_plot <- bind_rows(df_plot, df_wb)
  }
  
  # --- 4. 動態產生副標題文字 ---
  subtitle_text <- ""
  if (mode == "compare") {
    subtitle_text <- paste0("Lognormal: ", ln_prior_type, " | Weibull: ", wb_prior_type)
  } else if (mode == "lognormal") {
    subtitle_text <- paste0("Prior: ", ln_prior_type)
  } else {
    subtitle_text <- paste0("Prior: ", wb_prior_type)
  }
  
  # --- 5. 繪圖 ---
  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = sigma_sq, y = density, color = Model, fill = Model)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    # geom_area(position = "identity", alpha = 0.2) + # 若需要填充顏色可打開
    
    labs(
      title = "Random Effect Distribution of Sigma Squared",
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = expression(paste("Scale parameter ", sigma^2)),
      y = "Density",
      color = "Model",
      fill = "Model"
    ) +
    
    xlim(0, x_max) +
    ylim(0, y_max) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Lognormal" = "#E41A1C", 
                                  "Weibull" = "#377EB8")) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray30"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

## 調出負概似值
```{r}
get_individual_nll_v2 <- function(par, copper_data, 
                                  dist_type = "lognormal", 
                                  prior_type = "gamma") {
  # 1. 參數解析 (直接讀取原始尺度，不再使用 exp)
  beta0 <- par[1]
  beta1 <- par[2]
  kappa <- par[3] # 原始 kappa
  
  if (prior_type == "exponential") {
    delta <- 1
    gamma_limit <- par[4]
  } else {
    delta <- par[4] # 原始 delta
    gamma_limit <- par[5]
  }

  n <- nrow(copper_data)
  individual_nlls <- numeric(n)
  
  # 邊界與物理限制檢查
  if (kappa <= 0 || delta <= 0) return(rep(1e12, n))
  min_stress_fail <- min(copper_data$stress[copper_data$censoring == 1])
  if (gamma_limit >= min_stress_fail || gamma_limit <= 0) return(rep(1e12, n))

  # 逐一樣本計算積分 (Marginal Likelihood for each observation)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    row <- copper_data[i, ]
    stress_adj <- row$stress - gamma_limit
    
    if (stress_adj <= 0) {
      individual_nlls[i] <- 1e12
      next
    }
    
    mu_i <- beta0 + beta1 * log(stress_adj)
    log_y <- log(row$cycles)
    cens <- row$censoring
    
    # 單一樣本的被積函數
    integrand_log_single <- function(s2) {
      s <- sqrt(s2)
      z <- (log_y - mu_i) / s
      
      # 壽命分布項
      if (dist_type == "lognormal") {
        # Lognormal: 失效用 phi(z)/s, 截尾用 1-Phi(z)
        term_obs <- ifelse(cens == 1, 
                           dnorm(z, log = TRUE) - log(s), 
                           pnorm(z, lower.tail = FALSE, log.p = TRUE))
      } else { # Weibull (SEV)
        # Weibull: 失效用 z - exp(z) - log(s), 截尾用 -exp(z)
        term_obs <- ifelse(cens == 1, 
                           z - exp(z) - log(s), 
                           -exp(z))
      }
      
      # 先驗分布項 (Prior term for random effect)
      term_prior <- switch(prior_type,
        "gamma"       = (delta - 1) * log(s2) - (kappa * s2),
        "exponential" = - (kappa * s2),
        "inv_gamma"   = -(delta + 1) * log(s2) - (kappa / s2)
      )
      return(term_obs + term_prior)
    }

    # 數值穩定化處理 (Offset 技巧)
    test_s2 <- c(0.001, 0.1, 1, 10)
    sample_v <- sapply(test_s2, integrand_log_single)
    C_i <- max(sample_v[is.finite(sample_v)], -700)
    
    integrand_stable <- function(s2) {
      vapply(s2, function(x) {
        val <- exp(integrand_log_single(x) - C_i)
        return(if (is.finite(val)) val else 0)
      }, numeric(1))
    }

    itg <- try(integrate(integrand_stable, lower = 1e-10, upper = Inf, rel.tol = 1e-7), silent = TRUE)
    
    # 標準化常數 (使用原始參數)
    norm_const <- switch(prior_type,
      "gamma"       = delta * log(kappa) - lgamma(delta),
      "exponential" = log(kappa),
      "inv_gamma"   = delta * log(kappa) - lgamma(delta)
    )
    
    # 失效數據需加上 Jacobian 項 log(1/y) = -log(y)
    log_jacobian <- if(cens == 1) -log(row$cycles) else 0
    
    if (inherits(itg, "try-error") || itg$value <= 0) {
      individual_nlls[i] <- 1e12
    } else {
      # 邊際概似值 L(y_i) = \int f(y_i|s2) p(s2) ds2
      log_lik_marginal <- norm_const + C_i + log(itg$value) + log_jacobian
      individual_nlls[i] <- -log_lik_marginal
    }
  }
  
  return(individual_nlls)
}
```

## 結果整理輔助函數
```{r}
# 抽出 3 個分析區段重複的「計算後驗 sigma 表 → 標籤 → 比較圖」流程。
# sigma_prior_type 對應 calculate_sigma_posterior_v4 的命名（"inv_gamma" / "gamma" / "exp"）。
run_re_comparison <- function(ln_fit, wb_fit,
                              sigma_prior_type,
                              title_text,
                              use_prior_mean = FALSE,
                              raw_data = data) {
  sigma_table_ln <- calculate_sigma_posterior_v4(
    opt_obj = ln_fit, data = raw_data,
    distribution = "lognormal", prior_type = sigma_prior_type,
    use_prior_mean = use_prior_mean
  ) %>% mutate(model = "lognormal")

  sigma_table_wb <- calculate_sigma_posterior_v4(
    opt_obj = wb_fit, data = raw_data,
    distribution = "weibull", prior_type = sigma_prior_type,
    use_prior_mean = use_prior_mean
  ) %>% mutate(model = "weibull")

  p <- plot_comparison_curves(
    model_results_list = list(sigma_table_ln, sigma_table_wb),
    raw_data = raw_data,
    probs = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9),
    title_text = title_text
  )
  print(p)
  invisible(list(ln = sigma_table_ln, wb = sigma_table_wb, plot = p))
}
```

# Weighted Bootstrap 
```{r}
neg.log.likelihood.fatigue.fwb <- function(par, copper_data, 
                                           dist_type = "lognormal", 
                                           prior_type = "gamma",
                                           weights = NULL) {
  n <- nrow(copper_data)
  if (is.null(weights)) weights <- rep(1, n)
  
  # 直接讀取原始尺度參數
  beta0 <- par[1]; beta1 <- par[2]; kappa <- par[3]
  
  if (prior_type == "exponential") {
    delta <- 1; gamma_limit <- par[4]
  } else {
    delta <- par[4]; gamma_limit <- par[5]
  }

  # 邊界與正值檢查
  if (kappa <= 0 || delta <= 0) return(1e12)
  min_stress_fail <- min(copper_data$stress[copper_data$censoring == 1])
  if (gamma_limit >= min_stress_fail || gamma_limit <= 0) return(1e12)
  
  fail_idx <- copper_data$censoring == 1
  log_jacobian_total <- -sum(weights[fail_idx] * log(copper_data$cycles[fail_idx]))
  
  total_log_likelihood <- 0
  stress_levels <- unique(copper_data$stress)
  
  for (stress in stress_levels) {
    curr_idx <- which(copper_data$stress == stress)
    curr <- copper_data[curr_idx, ]; curr_w <- weights[curr_idx]
    
    mu_j <- beta0 + beta1 * log(stress - gamma_limit) 
    log_y <- log(curr$cycles); cens <- curr$censoring
    
    integrand_log <- function(s2) {
      s <- sqrt(s2)
      z <- (log_y - mu_j) / s
      term_obs <- if (dist_type == "lognormal") {
        ifelse(cens == 1, dnorm(z, log = TRUE) - log(s), pnorm(z, lower.tail = FALSE, log.p = TRUE))
      } else {
        ifelse(cens == 1, z - exp(z) - log(s), -exp(z))
      }
      
      term_prior <- switch(prior_type,
        "gamma"       = (delta - 1) * log(s2) - (kappa * s2),
        "exponential" = - (kappa * s2),
        "inv_gamma"   = -(delta + 1) * log(s2) - (kappa / s2)
      )
      return(sum(curr_w * term_obs) + term_prior)
    }

    sample_v <- sapply(c(0.001, 0.1, 1), integrand_log)
    C <- max(sample_v[is.finite(sample_v)], -700)
    integrand_stable <- function(s2) {
      vapply(s2, function(x) {
        val <- exp(integrand_log(x) - C)
        return(if (is.finite(val)) val else 0)
      }, numeric(1))
    }

    itg <- try(integrate(integrand_stable, lower = 1e-10, upper = Inf), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(itg, "try-error") || itg$value <= 0) return(1e12)
    
    norm_const <- switch(prior_type,
      "gamma" = delta * log(kappa) - lgamma(delta),
      "exponential" = log(kappa),
      "inv_gamma" = delta * log(kappa) - lgamma(delta)
    )
    total_log_likelihood <- total_log_likelihood + norm_const + C + log(itg$value)
  }
  
  final_nll <- -(total_log_likelihood + log_jacobian_total)
  return(if (is.finite(final_nll)) final_nll else 1e12)
}
```

```{r}
library(fwb)

# 核心計算邏輯：對應您提供的公式
calc_fatigue_quantile_logic <- function(pars, s, p, dist_type, model_type, prior_type, sigma_val) {
  # 1. 取得 Fatigue Limit (gamma)
  # pars 順序：b0, b1, log_k, (log_d), gamma
  n_par <- length(pars)
  gamma_val <- pars[n_par]
  
  # 2. 計算 mu (location) [cite: 113, 526]
  mu_j <- pars[1] + pars[2] * log(s - gamma_val)
  
  # 3. 取得標準化分位數 (z) [cite: 110, 513, 557]
  q_std <- if(dist_type == "lognormal") qnorm(p) else log(-log(1 - p))
  
  # 4. 回傳對數壽命
  return(mu_j + q_std * sigma_val)
}
```

```{r}
run_fwb_random_effect <- function(data, dist_type = "lognormal", prior_type = "gamma", 
                                  R = 1000, init_params = NULL, 
                                  use_prior_mean = TRUE) {
  
  unique_stresses <- sort(unique(data$stress))
  p_levels <- c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)
  min_s <- min(data$stress[data$censoring == 1])
  
  # 初始值設定 (改為原始尺度，kappa/delta 為正值)
  if (is.null(init_params)) {
    init_params <- if(prior_type == "exponential") c(20, -2, 1, min_s*0.9) else c(20, -2, 1, 2, min_s*0.9)
  }
  
  # 設定 L-BFGS-B 邊界 (kappa, delta 下限設為 1e-6)
  n_par <- length(init_params)
  low_b <- c(-Inf, -Inf, 1e-6, if(prior_type != "exponential") 1e-6 else NULL, 0.001)
  up_b <- c(Inf, Inf, Inf, if(prior_type != "exponential") Inf else NULL, min_s - 0.001)

  fwb_stat <- function(d, w) {
    total_len <- n_par + (length(p_levels) * length(unique_stresses))
    
    res <- tryCatch({
      fit <- optim(par = init_params, fn = neg.log.likelihood.fatigue.fwb, 
                   copper_data = d, dist_type = dist_type, prior_type = prior_type,
                   weights = w, method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = low_b, upper = up_b)
      pars <- fit$par
      
      # 直接讀取原始尺度參數
      kappa_val <- pars[3]
      delta_val <- if(prior_type == "exponential") 1 else pars[4]
      
      # 計算 sigma 期望值
      sigma_prior <- if(prior_type == "inv_gamma") sqrt(kappa_val/(delta_val-1)) else sqrt(delta_val/kappa_val)
      
      all_q <- as.vector(sapply(p_levels, function(p) {
        sapply(unique_stresses, function(s) {
          current_sigma <- if(use_prior_mean) {
            sigma_prior
          } else {
            # 快速後驗更新
            curr_data <- d[d$stress == s, ]; curr_w <- w[d$stress == s]
            mu_j <- pars[1] + pars[2] * log(s - pars[n_par])
            ss_j <- sum(curr_w * (log(curr_data$cycles) - mu_j)^2)
            n_f <- sum(curr_w * curr_data$censoring)
            sqrt((kappa_val + 0.5 * ss_j) / (delta_val + 0.5 * n_f))
          }
          calc_fatigue_quantile_logic(pars, s, p, dist_type, model_type=1, prior_type, current_sigma)
        })
      }))
      c(pars, all_q)
    }, error = function(e) rep(NA, total_len))
    return(res)
  }

  return(fwb(data = data, statistic = fwb_stat, R = R))
}
```



```{r}
summarize_fatigue_fwb <- function(fwb_results, 
                                  dist_type = "lognormal", 
                                  prior_type = "gamma") {
  
  library(broom)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(gridExtra)

  # 1. 動態定義標籤 (必須與 run_fwb_random_effect 的 par_names 順序一致)
  # 順序：beta0, beta1, kappa, [delta], gamma
  is_exp <- (prior_type == "exponential")
  labels <- c("beta0_mu", "beta1_mu", "kappa")
  if(!is_exp) {
    # 根據你的 run_fwb 代碼，非 Exponential 會有第 4 個參數 delta
    labels <- c(labels, "delta")
  }
  labels <- c(labels, "gamma_limit") # gamma 永遠在最後 [cite: 146]
  
  n_par <- length(labels)
  
  # 2. 建立摘要表格
  # 使用百分位數法 (perc) 計算信賴區間 [cite: 173, 174]
  boot_summary <- tidy(fwb_results, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95, conf.method = "perc")
  
  # 只取前 n_par 行 (排除後方應力分位數的列)
  boot_summary <- boot_summary[1:n_par, ]
  boot_summary$term <- labels
  
  # 計算變異係數 (CV) 以評估精確度 
  boot_summary$cv <- abs(boot_summary$std.error / boot_summary$statistic)
  
  cat("\n---", toupper(dist_type), "隨機效應模型參數摘要 (Bootstrap CI) ---\n")
  print(as.data.frame(boot_summary))
  
  # 3. 準備繪圖資料
  boot_df <- as.data.frame(fwb_results$t[, 1:n_par])
  colnames(boot_df) <- labels
  boot_df <- na.omit(boot_df)

  # 4. 繪圖循環 (維持你原本 local 的優良寫法)
  plot_list <- list()
  for(i in 1:n_par) {
    plot_list[[i]] <- local({
      idx <- i
      term_name <- labels[idx]
      orig_val <- fwb_results$t0[idx]
      
      qs <- quantile(boot_df[[term_name]], c(0.02, 0.025, 0.975, 0.98), na.rm = TRUE)
      
      p <- ggplot(boot_df, aes(x = .data[[term_name]])) +
        geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 30, 
                       fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_density(color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = orig_val, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) + # 原始估計值 [cite: 152]
        geom_vline(xintercept = qs[2], linetype = "dotted", color = "darkred", linewidth = 0.8) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = qs[3], linetype = "dotted", color = "darkred", linewidth = 0.8) +
        coord_cartesian(xlim = c(qs[1], qs[4])) +
        labs(title = paste(toupper(dist_type), "-", term_name), 
             subtitle = paste("MLE Est:", round(orig_val, 4), " (95% CI Line)"),
             x = "Bootstrap Estimate", 
             y = "Density") +
        theme_minimal()
      return(p)
    })
  }
  
  # 5. 排版輸出
  grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list, ncol = 2)
  
  return(list(summary_table = boot_summary, boot_dist = boot_df))
}
```

```{r}
get_distribution_bands_6lines <- function(fwb_res, data) {
  # 獲取應力水準與百分位數設定
  stress_tags <- sort(unique(data$stress))
  p_levels <- c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)
  boot_matrix <- fwb_res$t
  
  # 檢查 boot_matrix 是否有正確的列名稱 (需與 run_fwb_random_effect 對接)
  if (is.null(colnames(boot_matrix))) {
    stop("fwb_res$t 缺少列名稱，請確保 run_fwb_random_effect 有正確命名輸出向量。")
  }
  
  # 建立結果表格，以應力為基礎
  res_table <- data.frame(stress = stress_tags)
  
  # 針對每個 p-level (0.1, 0.5, 0.9) 分別計算
  for (p in p_levels) {
    # 定義輸出表格中的欄位名稱，例如 p0.1_Lower, p0.1_Upper
    low_col_name <- paste0("p", p, "_Lower")
    up_col_name  <- paste0("p", p, "_Upper")
    
    res_table[[low_col_name]] <- NA
    res_table[[up_col_name]]  <- NA
    
    for (i in 1:length(stress_tags)) {
      s_val <- stress_tags[i]
      
      # 精確匹配該應力與該分位數的列名稱，例如 "p0.1_s80.3"
      target_col <- paste0("p", p, "_s", s_val)
      
      if (target_col %in% colnames(boot_matrix)) {
        # 提取該應力水準下，該分位數的所有 Bootstrap 樣本
        boot_vals <- boot_matrix[, target_col]
        boot_vals <- boot_vals[!is.na(boot_vals)]
        
        if (length(boot_vals) > 0) {
          # 計算 95% 信賴區間並轉回原始循環數尺度 (exp) [cite: 109, 542]
          res_table[i, low_col_name] <- exp(quantile(boot_vals, 0.025))
          res_table[i, up_col_name]  <- exp(quantile(boot_vals, 0.975))
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(res_table)
}
```

```{r}
# 定義一個函數來處理欄位命名與匯出
export_fwb_to_csv <- function(fwb_res, data, file_name, prior_type) {
  # 1. 提取 Bootstrap 結果矩陣
  boot_matrix <- as.data.frame(fwb_res$t)
  
  # 2. 動態生成欄位名稱
  unique_stresses <- sort(unique(data$stress))
  p_levels <- c("p0.1", "p0.5", "p0.9")
  
  # 基礎參數名稱 (根據您使用的先驗分佈判斷參數個數)
  if (prior_type == "exponential") {
    param_names <- c("beta0", "beta1", "kappa", "gamma")
  } else {
    param_names <- c("beta0", "beta1", "kappa", "delta", "gamma")
  }
  
  # 分位數名稱 (例如 p0.1_s80, p0.5_s80...)
  quantile_names <- as.vector(t(outer(p_levels, unique_stresses, function(p, s) paste0(p, "_s", s))))
  
  # 合併所有欄位名稱
  colnames(boot_matrix) <- c(param_names, quantile_names)
  
  # 3. 寫入 CSV 檔
  write.csv(boot_matrix, file = file_name, row.names = FALSE)
  message(paste("成功匯出:", file_name))
}

# --- 執行匯出 ---

# 1. 匯出 Lognormal 資料
export_fwb_to_csv(fwb_re_ln, data, "fwb_re_lognormal.csv", prior_type = "gamma")

# 2. 匯出 Weibull 資料
export_fwb_to_csv(fwb_re_wb, data, "fwb_re_weibull.csv", prior_type = "exponential")
```

```{r}
summarize_fatigue_csv <- function(csv_path, 
                                 dist_type = "lognormal", 
                                 prior_type = "gamma",
                                 t0 = NULL) {
  
  library(ggplot2)
  library(gridExtra)

  # 1. 讀取 CSV 資料
  boot_df <- read.csv(csv_path)
  
  # 2. 定義參數標籤 (順序必須與匯出時一致：beta0, beta1, kappa, [delta], gamma)
  is_exp <- (prior_type == "exponential")
  labels <- c("beta0_mu", "beta1_mu", "kappa")
  if (!is_exp) {
    labels <- c(labels, "delta")
  }
  labels <- c(labels, "gamma_limit") # gamma 始終在參數列的最後 [cite: 117]
  
  n_par <- length(labels)
  
  # 3. 擷取參數部分的資料 (只取前 n_par 欄)
  param_df <- boot_df[, 1:n_par]
  colnames(param_df) <- labels
  param_df <- na.omit(param_df)
  
  # 4. 處理點估計值 (t0) 的長度對齊
  if (is.null(t0)) {
    point_estimates <- colMeans(param_df, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    # 重點修正：如果傳入的 t0 包含分位數 (例如 83 個元素)，只取前 n_par 個
    if (length(t0) > n_par) {
      point_estimates <- t0[1:n_par]
      message(paste("系統偵測到 t0 包含分位數數據，已自動擷取前", n_par, "個基礎參數。"))
    } else {
      point_estimates <- t0
    }
  }
  
  # 5. 建立摘要表格
  boot_summary <- data.frame(
    term = labels,
    estimate = point_estimates,
    std.error = sapply(param_df, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    conf.low = sapply(param_df, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    conf.high = sapply(param_df, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  # 計算變異係數 (CV)
  boot_summary$cv <- abs(boot_summary$std.error / boot_summary$estimate)
  
  cat("\n---", toupper(dist_type), "模型參數摘要 (Bootstrap CI) ---\n")
  print(as.data.frame(boot_summary))
  
  # 6. 繪圖循環
  plot_list <- list()
  for(i in 1:n_par) {
    plot_list[[i]] <- local({
      idx <- i
      term_name <- labels[idx]
      orig_val <- point_estimates[idx]
      
      vals <- param_df[[term_name]]
      qs <- quantile(vals, c(0.02, 0.025, 0.975, 0.98), na.rm = TRUE)
      
      p <- ggplot(data.frame(x = vals), aes(x = x)) +
        geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 30, 
                       fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_density(color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = orig_val, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) + 
        geom_vline(xintercept = qs[2], linetype = "dotted", color = "darkred", linewidth = 0.8) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = qs[3], linetype = "dotted", color = "darkred", linewidth = 0.8) +
        coord_cartesian(xlim = c(qs[1], qs[4])) +
        labs(title = paste(toupper(dist_type), "-", term_name), 
             subtitle = paste("MLE Est:", round(orig_val, 4)),
             x = "Estimate", y = "Density") +
        theme_minimal()
      return(p)
    })
  }
  
  grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list, ncol = 2)
  
  return(list(summary_table = boot_summary, boot_dist = param_df))
}


```

```{r}
# 定義從 CSV 提取 6 條邊界線數據的函數
prepare_plot_data <- function(csv_path) {
  # 讀取 CSV
  boot_df <- read.csv(csv_path)
  col_names <- colnames(boot_df)
  
  # 辨識所有的應力水準 (從欄位名稱中提取)
  # 假設名稱格式為 p0.1_s80, p0.5_s80 ...
  q_cols <- col_names[grepl("^p[0-9.]+_s", col_names)]
  stresses <- as.numeric(unique(gsub("^p[0-9.]+_s", "", q_cols)))
  stresses <- sort(stresses)
  
  p_levels <- c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)
  
  # 建立結果資料框
  res_table <- data.frame(stress = stresses)
  
  for (p in p_levels) {
    low_col <- paste0("p", p, "_Lower")
    up_col  <- paste0("p", p, "_Upper")
    
    # 初始化欄位
    res_table[[low_col]] <- NA
    res_table[[up_col]]  <- NA
    
    for (i in 1:length(stresses)) {
      s_val <- stresses[i]
      target_col_name <- paste0("p", p, "_s", s_val)
      
      if (target_col_name %in% col_names) {
        # 提取該應力下該分位數的所有 Bootstrap 樣本
        boot_vals <- boot_df[[target_col_name]]
        
        # 計算 95% 區間並轉回原始尺度 (exp)
        # 註：模型是在對數尺度建模，故需 exp 轉回實際循環數
        res_table[i, low_col] <- exp(quantile(boot_vals, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE))
        res_table[i, up_col]  <- exp(quantile(boot_vals, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
      }
    }
  }
  return(res_table)
}

# --- 執行轉換 ---
# 1. 處理對數常態資料
plot_re_ln <- prepare_plot_data("fwb_re_lognormal.csv")

# 2. 處理韋伯資料
plot_re_wb <- prepare_plot_data("fwb_re_weibull.csv")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 將 wide 格式的信賴帶（plot_re_*）轉為 long format：stress, Quantile, Lower, Upper, Distribution
to_long_bands <- function(bands_wide, distribution) {
  bands_wide %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("p"),
      names_to = c("Quantile", ".value"),
      names_pattern = "p(.+)_(Lower|Upper)"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Quantile = factor(paste0(as.numeric(Quantile) * 100, "%"),
                        levels = c("10%", "50%", "90%")),
      Distribution = distribution
    )
}

bands_long <- bind_rows(
  to_long_bands(plot_re_ln, "Lognormal"),
  to_long_bands(plot_re_wb, "Weibull")
)

# 視覺參數（Weibull 陰影較淺以減少視覺壓力）
alpha_fill_map <- c("Lognormal" = 0.5, "Weibull" = 0.25)
line_lwd       <- 0.7
line_alpha     <- 0.7

p_compare <- ggplot() +
  # 信賴帶陰影：以 Quantile 配色、依分佈調整透明度
  geom_ribbon(data = bands_long,
              aes(y = stress, xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper,
                  fill = Quantile, alpha = Distribution,
                  group = interaction(Distribution, Quantile)),
              orientation = "y") +
  # 上下界線：依分佈使用實線（Lognormal）／虛線（Weibull）
  geom_path(data = bands_long,
            aes(y = stress, x = Lower, color = Quantile,
                linetype = Distribution,
                group = interaction(Distribution, Quantile)),
            linewidth = line_lwd, alpha = line_alpha) +
  geom_path(data = bands_long,
            aes(y = stress, x = Upper, color = Quantile,
                linetype = Distribution,
                group = interaction(Distribution, Quantile)),
            linewidth = line_lwd, alpha = line_alpha) +
  # 觀測點
  geom_point(data = data, aes(x = cycles, y = stress, shape = factor(censoring)),
             color = "blue", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("10%" = "green", "50%" = "red", "90%" = "purple"),
                     name = "Quantile") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("10%" = "green", "50%" = "red", "90%" = "purple"),
                    name = "Quantile C.I.") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Lognormal" = "solid", "Weibull" = "dashed"),
                        name = "Distribution") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = alpha_fill_map, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("0" = 2, "1" = 16),
                     labels = c("0" = "Runout", "1" = "Failure"),
                     name = "Status") +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log",
                     breaks = trans_breaks("log10", function(x) 10^x),
                     labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log", labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "S-N diagram of final model with 95% C.I. for Nickel-Based Superalloy",
       subtitle = "the confident interval of quantile",
       x = "thousands of cycles", y = "stress") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "right")

print(p_compare)
```
